description: Sisyphus Phase 4 security policy specification. Goose 1.56.0 does not natively support pattern-based rules (e.g., command arguments or file path matching) in its permission.yaml, which is tool-name-based only. This file defines the required security policy; enforcement of pattern-based rules requires a custom enforcement layer or an external wrapper.
enforcement_notes: Goose 1.56.0 only supports tool-level permissions in ~/.config/goose/permission.yaml (always_allow, ask_before, never_allow). The pattern rules below cannot be enforced by goose natively; they must be enforced via a wrapper, supervisor, or custom security layer.

rules.reason: Prevent access to environment variables or files containing secrets.
Require explicit approval before pushing to the main branch.
